source: Simulated TRS and TEA records from record_linkage_workshop.R
deterministic_rules: standardized last name, first initial, and DOB
full standardized name and DOB within one day
blocking: first letter of standardized last name
selection: one-to-one greedy selection in descending score order
known_gaps: Simulation has a complete answer key, limited name diversity, one corruption per affected match, and no missing fields or group-specific error process. Real administrative files need clerical review and independent validation.
